raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "be"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "a content creator on TikTok"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "have followers"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "48000"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "focus on"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "beauty and lifestyle"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "earn"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "31000 lei"
  role source "brand collaborations"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  valid on "2026"

@s5 stated
  relation "work with"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "Farmec"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s6 stated
  relation "work with"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "an online clothing store from Oradea"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s7 stated
  relation "declare"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "income"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s8 stated
  relation "have heard that"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "PFA or copyright registration is needed"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty hedged

@s9 stated
  relation "have heard that"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "CASS is paid above a certain threshold"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty hedged

@q query
  select ?amount
  where match
    relation "owe to the state"
    role subject "the user"
    role object ?amount
    role topic "31000 lei income"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?deadline
  where match
    relation "must be filed"
    role subject "the unique declaration"
    role time ?deadline
    polarity affirmed
  end
